description: Human twin of auth-logout-with-env-key: no `signed out` line is printed.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: That command isn't quite right.
Detail: OPENPROSE_API_KEY is set; `cli auth logout` removes only the stored key, so commands would keep using OPENPROSE_API_KEY
Action: Unset OPENPROSE_API_KEY to stop using that key; then `prose cli auth logout` removes the stored key.
